Which shortwave stations broadcast in Oromo?

In the A-26 schedule, 8 stations broadcast in Oromo. The most heavily scheduled include BBC, Trans World Radio, IRRS Oromia Nat.Media, V.o.Oromo Liberation.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Oromo?

The most-used frequencies are 9500, 9780, 17640, 6030, 9540 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
